## TDD Workflow

> Задачи идут в порядке Red → Green → Refactor. Сначала фиксируем BDD-сценарии для mid-session поведения, затем меняем hook-код и регистрацию, затем проверяем, что фича доезжает до canonical plugin users.

## Phase 0: BDD Foundation (Red)

- [ ] Add mid-session reaper BDD scenarios -- CMEMMID001-CMEMMID006 — id: cmem-mid-01 — Status: TODO | Est: 30m
  _Requirements: [FR-1](FR.md), [FR-2](FR.md), [FR-3](FR.md), [FR-4](FR.md), [FR-5](FR.md), [FR-6](FR.md)_

## Phase 1: Mid-session Reaper Logic (Green)

- [ ] Extend `tools/claude-mem-health/health-check.ts` with mid-session guard mode -- CMEMMID001-CMEMMID003 — id: cmem-mid-02 — Status: TODO | Est: 45m
  _Requirements: [FR-1](FR.md), [FR-2](FR.md), [FR-3](FR.md)_
  **Done When:**
  - [ ] The hook can run as a pre-tool guard and reuse the existing `reaperDecision` / reaper path instead of duplicating Windows process logic.
  - [ ] A healthy worker returns quickly without recording kills or mutating hook-failure state.
  - [ ] A full check inside the debounce window skips the worker probe and OS snapshot entirely.

- [ ] Preserve surgical kill scope and fail-open behavior -- CMEMMID001, CMEMMID005 — id: cmem-mid-03 — Status: TODO | Est: 45m
  _Requirements: [FR-1](FR.md), [FR-5](FR.md)_
  **Done When:**
  - [ ] A wedged Windows snapshot records only the orphaned `chroma-mcp` / claude-mem socket-holder pid and does not kill unrelated processes.
  - [ ] Non-Windows and `DEV_POMOGATOR_CLAUDE_MEM_REAP=off` return `continue:true` without deny/block output.
  - [ ] Any internal reaper error is caught and converted into a continue payload.

## Phase 2: Distribution and Visibility (Green)

- [ ] Register the mid-session guard in plugin and dogfood hook manifests -- CMEMMID004 — id: cmem-mid-04 — Status: TODO | Est: 30m
  _Requirements: [FR-4](FR.md)_
  **Done When:**
  - [ ] `.claude-plugin/hooks.json` includes a PreToolUse entry that launches `tools/claude-mem-health/health-check.ts` through the plugin bootstrap path.
  - [ ] `.claude/settings.json` includes the matching dogfood PreToolUse entry through the project bootstrap path.
  - [ ] The hook command remains plugin-distributed and does not require user-local `node_modules` packages.

- [ ] Add visible non-blocking stale-memory notice -- CMEMMID006 — id: cmem-mid-05 — Status: TODO | Est: 45m
  _Requirements: [FR-6](FR.md)_
  **Done When:**
  - [ ] The guard records when claude-mem first becomes unavailable and clears that marker when health returns.
  - [ ] After the visibility threshold, the guard emits a visible warning that memory has not been recording for the measured duration.
  - [ ] The warning is rate-limited and the hook still returns `continue:true`.
